events.title: Patch 0.1.11 & Previous Updates
events.summary: Over the past few days I've been working through the reports and suggestions received since the Alpha Demo was released.Several patches have already been released, focusing on stability, campaign loading, performance, UI readability and scaling, onboarding, military controls and scenario corrections.There's still a lot of work to do. Some systems are still early implementations, and I'm continuing to identify areas that need to be clearer, more intuitive or reworked entirely before Early Access.

events.title: STATO Demo Patch 0.1.5
events.summary: Improved construction map transparency, icons and building counts, including queued buildings.Added tooltips explaining why construction is unavailable.Fixed city label alignment while zooming.Added separate UI and music volume controls with mute options.Added resolution selection for fullscreen and windowed modes.Added confirmation when returning to the main menu.

events.title: The STATO (ALPHA) Demo is Now Available!
events.summary: The first public ALPHA Demo of STATO is now available.This is an early development build. Some systems are still incomplete, unbalanced, or subject to change.You can currently try both the historical scenario and the procedural world generation mode.Feedback and bug reports are welcome and will help us improve STATO as development continues toward Early Access.Thank you for your support.
